purpose: Train the resident fused 32B's recurrent-window operator under the CP138 broad curriculum (12 families, registry 2026.07.18.2) through the exact live latent-slot execution graph, so the frozen-loop refutation (vanilla beats untrained recurrence) is answered by a recurrence-NATIVE operator rather than a clever frozen runtime.

model.role: the resident desktop checkpoint — the only model whose improvement counts

dataset.seed_disjointness: train seed 1777 is disjoint from every eval seed (20260717, 20260718, 20260719, 20260801-20260820)

execution_shape.rationale: train under the shape the runtime actually executes, with curriculum depth beyond the live 2-step profile so additional thought is trained to help (monotonicity hinge)

preflight.purpose: infrastructure feasibility ONLY (required by the void verdict's 'preflight wall-clock and compute-budget feasibility estimates'); never capability evidence
preflight.frozen_rule: median seconds-per-step over the 3 preflight steps > 75 implies per_cell drops to the fallback 8 (288 samples); otherwise per_cell stays 16 (576 samples). No other parameter may change in response to the preflight.

sessions.sessions_2_3: explicit --resume relaunches of the identical command in a fresh supervisor run-dir (supervisor never restarts on its own; the trainer owns durable exact-resume state)
sessions.hard_stop: after session 3 the adapter is whatever the last durable checkpoint holds; no further training may be attributed to this preregistration

training_command_argv: <16 or 8 per the frozen preflight rule>

supervisor.resume_contract: none (explicit relaunch with the trainer's own --resume; the supervisor never restarts a failed target)
supervisor.certified_by: CP137 detached v2 mechanics (commit 89df1de1): sandbox_no_fork, process-group containment, atomic heartbeat/status, exactly one terminal receipt

memory_safety.rule: the live Aura desktop app must be DOWN for the entire run; one 32B process maximum on the 64GB host
memory_safety.verified_at_prereg: no aura_main process, port 8000 dead, 23.0 GB free

requirements: terminal state is training_completion (complete) OR halt_reason wall_clock with >= 200 total steps
adapter + optimizer + completion records durable (latest.json advanced only after all three)
strict v2 plan-only loader accepts the bundle
mechanical_admission.on_failure: REFUTED-mechanics; no evaluation compute is spent on the adapter

proceed_to_powered_iff: paired effect of adapter-on(RLC-on) versus adapter-off(RLC-on) on the pilot's primary endpoint is >= 0
zero checkpoint-invariant or identity failures across all arms
pilot_decision_rule.otherwise: record the honest pilot verdict, shelve the adapter, and do NOT run the powered campaign under this preregistration

prerequisites: signed contamination audit with status passed_zero_overlap and verified signature
contamination trust root independent of this repository's writable state
prospective_powered_campaign.claim_gate: only this campaign may award or refute recurrence_native_adapter_improves_resident_32b

withdrawal_reason: A parallel session froze and launched the operative resident-32B v2 protocol (artifacts/closeout/latent_cortex/resident_32b_v2_cp139/protocol.json, commits 56ba0b56+1cf6df27) minutes before this preregistration could launch. Exactly one protocol may govern the run; this one never loaded a model, spent no compute, and is withdrawn in favor of the launched protocol. No training or evaluation may cite this document.
